CANONICAL_NAME.value: Paradigms of Artificial Intelligence Programming -- Norvig's Common Lisp programs (GPS, ELIZA, pattern matcher, unifier, Prolog-in-Lisp, 1991)

VERSION.value: github.com/norvig/paip-lisp main as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: The canonical Common Lisp exposition of classical AI machinery: Newell & Simon's General Problem Solver (means-ends analysis), Weizenbaum's ELIZA (pattern-directed rewriting), STUDENT, a unifier and a Prolog interpreter/compiler, search tools, Othello. Real problem-solving programs from the symbolic-AI culture, kept runnable by Norvig's repository under SBCL.

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: classical AI problem solving in Lisp

value.built_to: solve problems by reducing goal/state differences with operators (GPS), converse by pattern rewriting (ELIZA), and answer queries by unification and backtracking (Prolog)
value.pressure: the symbolic-AI programme's demand for general methods; the book's demand that they be small and readable
value.success_means: GPS finds the operator sequence the book prints; ELIZA responds; the Prolog interpreter answers member/append queries

value.pressure: combinatorial search, goal interaction (the 'prerequisite clobbers sibling goal' problem GPS exposes)
value.failure_condition: GPS loops or 'running around the block' (the book's own catalogue of GPS failures)
